page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It does not feature any GPU accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

The ecs.g6a.16xlarge is designed for workloads requiring a balanced distribution of compute and memory resources. Its hardware profile is suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-sized databases. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, offering a stable resource density for general-purpose enterprise deployments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at 2.6 GHz, paired with 256.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, requiring external block storage for data persistence. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given its dedicated compute allocation and balanced resource profile, the ecs.g6a.16xlarge is suited for enterprise applications, multi-tenant container hosting, web serving, and database workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the need for specialized hardware acceleration.
